title: Chen Ling's True Form
next_chapter_hook: "At the moment when the Xuanwu Sect disciples were about to make their move, a thunderous roar echoed from the distance—the sound of the Tianqing Sect Mountain Gate Formation being forcibly breached."

text.content: "In the shadows at the entrance of the ruins, the cold light refracted by that black iron token was like a venomous serpent's tongue, stabbing directly into Chen Ji's eyes. His body remained motionless, yet his pupils contracted sharply—the mark of imperial dynasty secret agents, all too familiar to him. The ambush three days ago had been their handiwork."

dialogue.content: "You don't need to stare at me so nervously, Chen Ji. From the shadows, a clear, cold female voice sounded, followed by a slender figure stepping out from the darkness—it was Chen Ling. She still wore that plain, unremarkable face, but in Chen Ji's eyes now, she was draped in a layer of impenetrable mist."

text.content: "Chen Ji slowly turned, his right hand seemingly hanging casually at his side, though in truth it had already quietly gripped the Tianji Record Fragment hidden in his sleeve. The urge to foresee the future surged in his heart, but every Heavenly Fate Value consumed was like a blade cutting into his very soul, forcing him to suppress the urge."

dialogue.content: "You must have many questions. Chen Ling smiled faintly, that smile carrying a depth he had never seen before—for instance—who am I really?"

text.content: "Chen Ji did not speak, merely watching her silently. The silence flowed between them, more oppressive than any words. Finally, Chen Ling sighed softly, breaking the dead silence."

dialogue.content: "My name is Chen Ling, that part is true. But I have another identity—Seventh Layer of the Hall of Heavenly Secrets, Fate Overseer. Chen Ling's voice was calm as if stating the weather. My mission is to ensure that every person who obtains the Tianji Record is not completely controlled by the Hall of Heavenly Secrets."

text.content: "These words struck Chen Ji's heart like a heavy hammer. The Hall of Heavenly Secrets! That mysterious organization said to dominate all seers in the world! He had thought obtaining the Tianji Record Fragment was coincidence, a tremendous fortune, never imagining that from the very beginning, he had been placed on some grander chessboard."

dialogue.content: "You're surely thinking—if I'm an Overseer, why would I cooperate with you? Chen Ling seemed to read his thoughts, a bitter curve forming at her lips. Because my mission isn't to monitor you, but to help you—help you walk your own path, rather than become a piece of the Hall of Heavenly Secrets."

text.content: "Chen Ji's eyes narrowed slightly, his thoughts churning like tides. Help him walk his own path? Beautiful words, but Chen Ji had never believed in kindness without reason. Moreover, if he truly was a piece selected by the Hall of Heavenly Secrets, then what right did this so-called 'Overseer' have to betray the Hall of Heavenly Secrets?"

choice.prompt: "Too many doubts hid within Chen Ling's words. Chen Ji had to make a judgment: was this woman before him friend or foe?"

choices.description: "Continue questioning Chen Ling about the real reason she betrays the Hall of Heavenly Secrets, probing for flaws in her words."
choices.visible_cost: "Risk missing the opportunity to obtain crucial information"
choices.visible_reward: "Gain more intelligence about the Hall of Heavenly Secrets"
choices.risk_hint: "Chen Ling may develop wariness as a result"

text.content: "Chen Ji snorted coldly, saying: 'Help me? A monitor of the Hall of Heavenly Secrets betrays the Hall to help me? Chen Ling, do you take me for a three-year-old?'"

dialogue.content: "Chen Ling did not get angry; instead, a flash of approval appeared in her eyes: 'You are indeed more cautious than I anticipated. That's good—it proves the Tianji Record didn't choose the wrong person.'"

choices.description: "Ask Chen Ling to provide actual sincerity or evidence to prove her words are true."

text.content: "Chen Ji's expression unchanged, he said calmly: 'Empty words, anyone can say them. If you truly have sincerity, why not show something real.'"

dialogue.content: "Chen Ling was silent for a moment, then took out an ancient, elegant jade pendant from her sleeve: 'This is the token of a Fate Overseer—in critical moments, it can summon me once. Does this count as sincerity?'"

choices.description: "Make no表态, continue observing Chen Ling's subsequent actions, using stillness to control movement."
choices.visible_cost: "May allow the other party to take the initiative"

text.content: "Chen Ji did not speak, merely tilted his head slightly, adopting an attitude of ready to listen. Silence, sometimes carried more power than any words."

dialogue.content: "Chen Ling seemed very satisfied with his reaction: 'You are more patient than I anticipated. That's good—what a Chess Player needs most is patience.'"

text.content: "Chess Player? Chen Ji frowned slightly—this was the second time the word had emerged from Chen Ling's mouth. The first time was when he obtained the Tianji Record Fragment, when Mo Xiansheng had also used this word to describe him. What did this truly mean?"

dialogue.content: "The Hall of Heavenly Secrets divides all seers into three categories. Chen Ling seemed to sense his confusion, explaining proactively: First, pieces—who can only passively accept fate's arrangements; second, chess players—who can manipulate others' fates; and third, Chess Players—existences capable of shaking Heaven itself."

text.content: "Chen Ji's heart suddenly accelerated. Shaking Heaven? His gaze involuntarily fell upon the Tianji Record Fragment in his sleeve. He had always thought the Tianji Record was merely a prophetic tool, never imagining its significance behind was this terrifying."

dialogue.content: "The Tianji Record consists of nine volumes—you are the only person in a hundred years to have gathered two volumes. Chen Ling's voice lowered. This is also why the Hall of Heavenly Secrets pays you so much attention. But my mission is to ensure you walk your own path, rather than becoming a puppet of the Hall of Heavenly Secrets."

text.content: "Before her words even finished, a sudden commotion came from outside the ruins. Chen Ji's expression changed slightly—he had keenly caught the spiritual energy fluctuation permeating the air—the distinctive cultivation technique aura of the Xuanwu Sect."

choice.prompt: "The Xuanwu Sect people arrived faster than anticipated. Chen Ji had to decide: whether to first resolve the immediate crisis, or continue interrogating Chen Ling's identity?"

choices.description: "The Xuanwu Sect visitors mean trouble—they must prioritize handling this external threat to ensure their own safety."
choices.visible_cost: "May interrupt dialogue with Chen Ling, missing important information"

text.content: "Chen Ji snorted coldly: 'Looks like some reckless fools have arrived. Chen Ling, your words can wait.' With that, his figure vanished from its spot."

choices.text: "Ask Chen Ling to stay and assist"
choices.description: "Since Chen Ling claims to be here to help, have her prove her worth—face the Xuanwu Sect threat together."
choices.visible_reward: "Test Chen Ling's sincerity while gaining reinforcements"

text.content: "Chen Ji turned to look at Chen Ling: 'Since you say you're here to help me, then first help me get rid of these uninvited guests.'"

dialogue.content: "Chen Ling nodded slightly, her form flickering as she appeared at the entrance of the ruins: 'Don't worry, they won't get through.'"

text.content: "Outside the ruins, the leading Xuanwu Sect disciple coldly laughed, followed by over a dozen Inner Sect experts. Spiritual energy pressed down like a physical force. His gaze swept over Chen Ling, a contemptuous curve forming at his lips: 'Tianqing Sect trash and an unknown woman? With just you, you dare block my Xuanwu Sect?'"

dialogue.content: "Chen Ling lightly raised her hand, an invisible barrier unfolding before her and Chen Ji, completely deflecting that oppressive force. Her voice was flat, as if stating some trivial matter: 'I advise you to go back. Today's business here is none of your concern.'"

text.content: "The Xuanwu Sect disciple seemed to have heard the funniest joke in the world, bursting into laughter: 'Hahahaha! A little girl dares to speak so wildly! Let's see what ability you—' Before he finished, his laughter abruptly stopped."

"Because in Chen Ling's eyes, a golden light suddenly flickered. That light carried a pressure that made every person present tremble from the depths of their souls—a suppression from a higher dimension, a gaze of fate itself looking down upon mortals."

choice.prompt: "Chen Ling revealed her true strength. The Xuanwu Sect disciples showed fear on their faces. At this critical moment, how should Chen Ji respond?"

choices.text: "Take advantage to humiliate the Xuanwu Sect"
choices.description: "Using Chen Ling's pressure, thoroughly humiliate the Xuanwu Sect disciples, displaying one's own momentum."
choices.visible_reward: "Greatly enhance Reputation, making the Xuanwu Sect lose face completely"
choices.risk_hint: "The Xuanwu Sect may harbor a grudge"

text.content: "Chen Ji walked out slowly, a mocking arc curving at his lips: 'Oh? Aren't you the proud disciples of the Xuanwu Sect? How was it? Weren't you being very impressive just now? Why do you all look like you've seen a ghost now?'"

dialogue.content: "The Xuanwu Sect disciple's face flushed to a pig's liver color, but suppressed by that pressure he couldn't speak a word, able only to glare furiously at Chen Ji."

choices.text: "Let them go after making the point"
choices.description: "Take the victory and stop there—warn them, then let them leave, avoiding forming a mortal enemy."
choices.visible_cost: "The Xuanwu Sect may think you are afraid"

text.content: "Chen Ji waved his hand, as if swatting a fly: 'Alright, alright, consider this a lesson for today. Go back and tell your Sect Master that Tianqing Sect affairs are none of the Xuanwu Sect's business. Get lost.'"

dialogue.content: "The Xuanwu Sect disciples, as if granted amnesty, fled the ruins scrambling over each other. Before leaving, the leader glanced back viciously at Chen Ji, his eyes full of venom."

text.content: "After the Xuanwu Sect people had gone far, Chen Ling收起 that pressure and turned to look at Chen Ji. Her gaze held more seriousness now: 'You should have seen my sincerity. Now, are you willing to let me finish?'"

dialogue.content: "Chen Ling took out an ancient, elegant jade pendant from her sleeve, solemnly presenting it to Chen Ji: 'This is the token of a Fate Overseer—in critical moments, it can summon me once. From now on, you and I are allies.'"

text.content: "Chen Ji accepted the jade pendant—it was warm and smooth to the touch, faintly resonating with a special power within. He tucked the jade pendant into his sleeve, then raised his head to meet Chen Ling's eyes directly: 'Very well, I'll believe you for now. But there's one thing you must tell me—what exactly is the Eye of Heavenly Fate?'"
